jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Ready to design the equipment behind circular concrete?

At everox, we transforming waste concrete into high-quality drop-in substitutes for cement, aggregates and sand. Our mission is to reduce global CO₂ emissions by 2% by phasing out the use of virgin materials in concrete via the patented everox waste concrete upcycling process.

We are now moving from pilots to industrial production. At our Rotterdam test site we develop and validate our process on small-scale pilots and in our own labs. Our first commercial facility in 's-Gravendeel is the next big step. After that: a second flagship plant abroad and new modular product lines that bring our technology to customers in containerised form.

**About the role**
------------------

As Mechanical Engineer, you are the 3D modelling and design strength of our mechanical team. You turn design input into accurate 3D models and drawings, and you are just as comfortable with your hands on the equipment.

The position sits in a small, hands-on engineering team of mechanical, process and automation engineers, reporting to our CTO. Besides your own projects, you work on the projects of both our Senior Mechanical Engineers: one focuses on our ’s-Gravendeel plant and future facilities, the other on our new containerised product lines.

Day to day, the work brings you together with these seniors, our process engineers and R&D, so you will receive direct coaching and build a broad knowledge of our technology from day one. Half of the time goes to our new modular product line, the other half to our test site, the operating facility in ’s-Gravendeel and the next international plants. International travel is part of the role for engineering reviews, factory acceptance tests, construction and commissioning of new plants.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Create 3D models, drawings and bills of materials based on design input from our Senior Mechanical Engineers, for our containerised products, pilots, prototypes and plant modifications.
* Turn concepts, sketches and redlines into complete drawing and fabrication packages, and keep our CAD models, drawing standards and part libraries consistent and up to date.
* Perform mechanical calculations, select components, request and compare quotations, and review supplier documentation.
* Complete the commissioning of our pilot-scale carbonation reactor and hand it over to R&D.
* Design and implement modifications on our small-scale pilots for carbonation, milling, crushing and sieving, and build and test prototypes together with R&D, for example for continuous carbonation.
* Prepare the mechanical design of modifications on our ’s-Gravendeel facility under management of change (MOC), and support the review of mechanical deliverables for the next flagship plant.
* Take part in FAT/SAT, installation and commissioning on site.
* Maintain mechanical documentation and revision control, contribute to risk assessments and design reviews, and help build a strong safety culture on site.

**What you bring**
------------------

We are looking for a mechanical engineer with a few years of experience who is as comfortable in a 3D model as next to a piece of equipment on site. Turning someone else’s input into an accurate model appeals to you, and when that input is incomplete, you ask the right questions. You want to learn from experienced engineers and grow in mechanical design, and you see pilots and prototypes as a chance to get your hands dirty.

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
* 3 to 4 years of experience in mechanical design and project execution, for example in machine building or industrial equipment.
* Strong skills in 3D parametric CAD (Autodesk Inventor preferred), including assemblies, drawings and bills of materials.
* The ability to turn input from others into accurate models and drawings.
* A hands-on, practical attitude: comfortable assembling, testing and troubleshooting equipment.
* Experience with, or a strong interest in, pilot, prototype or test installations.
* Fluent English; Dutch language skills are a plus.
* Willingness to travel internationally for engineering reviews, FAT and commissioning.

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Experience with bulk solids handling equipment, such as crushers, mills or screens.
* Experience with skid-mounted or containerised equipment.
* Experience with Autodesk Vault or another PDM system.
* Basic knowledge of CE marking and pressure equipment.
* A VCA certificate.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation based on the market, your experience and qualifications (€55,000-€65,000 gross per year including holiday allowance).
* Employee ownership through our ESOP and a company pension plan at Zwitserleven.
* 27 days of annual holiday leave.
* A one-year contract for 40 hours per week, with the intention to extend to a permanent contract.
* Training and development, including vendor training where relevant.
* Coaching by two Senior Mechanical Engineers, working side by side on their projects.
* An impactful position in a fast-growing, mission-driven scale-up.

**Why join us?**
----------------

We are a dynamic, diverse and international team located at SubZero, a hub for Greentech start-ups in the Port of Rotterdam. Our flat hierarchy gives you ownership of your work and room to grow, and the chance to help shape the engineering standards of a company moving from its first plant to multiple plants and products.

**Interested?**

Ready to design the equipment that turns waste concrete into new building materials? We would like to hear from you.

Even if you don’t meet every requirement, please apply - your unique background could be exactly what we need.

Would you like to contribute to the development of a high-tech product, that’s radically changing the world of printing? Would you like to get more involved with Lean Manufacturing and Continuous improvement? Would you like to utilize all above and work in a circular manufacturing environment? Then this might be the next step you are looking for!

  

*Questions about this position? Bram Frings, Recruitment, +316 29693168 /* *bram.frings@cpp.canon*

**Industrial Engineer – Circular Economy Manufacturing, CEM**

**40 hours per week, hybrid in Venlo (NL)**

  

**What you’ll do**

As an Industrial Engineer in the Circular Economy Manufacturing (CEM) department, you will drive the transformation from linear to circular manufacturing operations. You will design and improve processes for remanufacturing, refurbishment, repair, component harvesting, and material recovery, ensuring high yield, traceability, and cost effectiveness. Your focus will mainly be on all electronical, electrical and electro mechanical components of our product lines. You will lead cross-functional initiatives that integrate reverse logistics, design-for-disassembly, lifecycle thinking, and eco-efficiency—delivering measurable impact on sustainability, quality, and total cost of ownership.

This role focuses on designing, optimizing, and safeguarding circular processes across the organization. It involves developing complete end-to-end workflows covering intake, diagnostics, disassembly, refurbishment, remanufacturing, repair, testing, and re-delivery of products. A key responsibility is improving and generating business cases for circularity in the field of electronically components, controllers, computers, power supplies and all our electronical circuit boards in our products. Being the one face to our suppliers is part of the responsibility.

The position works closely with R&D to embed Design for Disassembly and Design for Circularity into future products, failure analyses, and structured feedback on reusability. It also includes establishing standards, KPIs, and compliance frameworks to ensure quality, sustainability, and adherence to ISO, UL and EU regulations.

Additionally, the role leads continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Industrial Engineering methodologies, while supporting digitalization and low-cost automation within circular operations. As a cross-functional expert, the role provides training, builds business cases, and drives major implementation projects.

Some key bullets;

* Circular process design & optimization; Develop end-to-end circular workflows, optimize disassembly and refurbishment lines, and establish process standards, especially for the electronically components of our products
* Ensure component availability, support closed-loop strategies with suppliers and generate new business cases to increase circularity at Canon
* Data, standards & compliance; Define and monitor KPIs, maintain standard work, and ensure compliance with ISO, UL and EU environmental requirements
* Lean & continuous improvement; Lead Kaizen/A3 initiatives, apply IE methods, and support digital inspection tools and automation.
* Cross-functional leadership & training
  

**What you bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Electrical/Electronical Engineering, or related. Preferred with a Circular or Sustainable Thesis, but not mandatory
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in manufacturing and circularity environments, including hands-on process optimization
* Strong competence in Lean Manufacturing, including practical experience with LEAN methodologies and 5S implementation
* Six Sigma Green Belt certification (or equivalent) preferred
* Strong interest in circularity and sustainability for manufacturing
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills (A3, DMAIC)
* Proficiency with Power BI for dashboards, yield trends, and KPI reporting
* Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, circularity-related compliance
* Strong communication skills with the ability to lead cross-functional projects, like business cases
* Fluent in English, Dutch and German preferred, but not mandatory

**Maintenance Engineer Elektrisch**  
Als Maintenance Engineer Elektrisch werk je aan de betrouwbaarheid van onze productie-installaties. Je bepaalt hoe we het onderhoud het beste kunnen inrichten en waar verbeteringen nodig zijn. Daarbij kijk je naar de technische mogelijkheden, de beschikbaarheid die productie nodig heeft en de kosten. Je werkt samen met collega’s van de technische dienst, productie en externe specialisten. Je rapporteert aan de Plantmanager en adviseert over onderhoud, technische aanpassingen en investeringen.

**Wat ga je doen?**

* Je ontwikkelt en beheert onderhoudsconcepten die aansluiten bij de installaties en de wensen van productie. Je bepaalt welk onderhoud nodig is, hoe vaak en waarom.
* Je maakt de betrouwbaarheid van installaties meetbaar. Je analyseert terugkerende storingen en de verhouding tussen preventief en correctief onderhoud en pakt de oorzaken van knelpunten aan.
* Je begeleidt derden bij investeringsprojecten, modificaties en onderhoudswerkzaamheden.
* Je onderzoekt nieuwe technieken en adviseert over toepassingen die onze installaties verbeteren of het onderhoud eenvoudiger maken.
* Je bepaalt welke reservedelen nodig zijn en adviseert over de voorraad op basis van kosten, baten en risico’s.
* Je bepaalt welke onderhoudswerkzaamheden worden uitbesteed en welke prestatieafspraken daarbij passen, in lijn met het beleid van de technische dienst.
* Je werkt verbeteringen en technische modificaties uit, onderbouwt deze met kosten-batenanalyses en begeleidt de uitvoering.
* Je adviseert de Plantmanager over nieuwbouw, verbouw en budgetten voor het komende jaar en de middellange termijn. Je werkt technische ontwerpen en projectvoorstellen uit.
* Je laat toetsen of installaties voldoen aan afspraken en wettelijke eisen en zorgt dat werkzaamheden volgens de veiligheids- en kwaliteitsvoorschriften verlopen, waaronder HACCP, GMP en Arbo.
* Je bent het schakelbevoegde aanspreekpunt voor de netbeheerder. Je geeft binnen jouw bevoegdheid toestemming voor koppel- en schakelwerkzaamheden en reparaties, bewaakt inspecties en onderhoud aan middenspanningsinstallaties en stemt af bij calamiteiten.
* Je ontwikkelt en verzorgt trainingen en werkplekopleidingen op basis van knelpunten en de kennis die collega’s nodig hebben.
* Je ontwikkelt rapportages in Ultimo die productie inzicht geven in onderhoud en betrouwbaarheid en helpen de kosten te beheersen.

**Wat breng je mee?**

* Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Elektrotechniek.
* Je hebt bij voorkeur minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen een onderhoudsorganisatie.
* Je analyseert storings- en onderhoudsgegevens en vertaalt deze naar praktische verbeteringen.
* Je beschikt over minimaal een geldig NEN 3140 VP-certificaat (Vakbekwaam Persoon) of bent bereid dit te behalen.
* Je hebt kennis van onderhoudsmanagement en inzicht in andere technische vakgebieden.
* Je hebt ervaring met een onderhoudsmanagementsysteem, bij voorkeur Ultimo.
* Je werkt nauwkeurig, vraagt door en onderbouwt jouw adviezen.
* Je communiceert makkelijk met monteurs, productie, leveranciers en management en deelt jouw kennis met collega’s.
* Je beheerst Duits en Engels in woord en geschrift.
* Je volgt ontwikkelingen in jouw vakgebied en bent bereid om aanvullende functiegerichte opleidingen te volgen.

**Wat bieden wij?**

* Een veelzijdige functie waarin je meedenkt over technische keuzes en betrokken bent bij de uitvoering.
* Een startsalaris vanaf €4.576 bruto per maand, met ruimte om hoger in te stappen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring.

Dossche Mills is een familiebedrijf met een geschiedenis die teruggaat tot 1875. We verwerken graan tot hoogwaardige grondstoffen voor bakkerijen en de voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Job Vacancy: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

**Company:** Theme Crafters Building Contracting LLC – TAA Group  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Mechanical Design Engineer** with strong expertise in **SolidWorks and Autodesk Fusion** to lead mechanical design development for custom-built structures, themed attractions, interactive installations, mechanical assemblies, and specialized fabrication projects.

The ideal candidate must combine advanced 3D CAD skills with practical engineering knowledge, ensuring that designs are not only technically accurate but also manufacturable, functional, and suitable for workshop fabrication, assembly, and site installation.

We need a hands-on engineer who can take a project from **initial concept and 3D modeling through detailed engineering, prototyping, fabrication, testing, and implementation**.

Key Responsibilities

**Mechanical Design & Engineering**

* Lead mechanical design development for custom structures, moving mechanisms, interactive features, themed attractions, and specialized installations.
* Create detailed 3D models, assemblies, and engineering drawings using **SolidWorks and Autodesk Fusion**.
* Prepare manufacturing drawings, fabrication details, exploded views, assembly drawings, and bills of materials (BOMs).
* Perform design calculations, component selection, tolerance analysis, and basic mechanical engineering assessments as required.
* Design mechanical systems involving linkages, gears, bearings, shafts, actuators, motors, and other moving components where applicable.
* Evaluate material selection, structural requirements, manufacturability, and mechanical performance.

**Prototyping, Fabrication & Implementation**

* Develop prototypes and test mechanical concepts before final production.
* Work closely with workshop and production teams to ensure designs can be fabricated and assembled efficiently.
* Provide hands-on technical support during fabrication, assembly, installation, and commissioning.
* Troubleshoot mechanical problems and modify designs based on actual workshop and site conditions.
* Conduct design reviews and improve existing mechanisms, assemblies, and fabrication methods.
* Verify that completed components and assemblies meet design requirements and intended functionality.

**Project Coordination**

* Coordinate with Architects, BIM Modelers, Electrical Engineers, Automation Engineers, Fabrication Teams, and Site Teams.
* Ensure mechanical designs are compatible with electrical systems, sensors, actuators, motors, and PLC-controlled equipment where applicable.
* Review technical drawings, identify design conflicts, and propose practical engineering solutions.
* Manage design revisions, technical documentation, and engineering deliverables according to project schedules.
* Support testing, troubleshooting, and final project handover.

Requirements

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum **7–10 years of relevant mechanical design engineering experience**.
* **Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks and Autodesk Fusion is mandatory.**
* Strong experience in 3D CAD modeling, complex assemblies, engineering drawings, and manufacturing documentation.
* Practical knowledge of machining, metal fabrication, welding, CNC manufacturing, and mechanical assembly.
* Experience in prototyping, product development, and converting concepts into working mechanical systems.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings and resolve engineering problems independently.
* Strong understanding of materials, tolerances, fasteners, bearings, gears, motors, and mechanical components.
* Experience coordinating with multidisciplinary teams and supporting workshop/site implementation.
* Strong communication, technical problem-solving, and leadership skills.

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following industries will be an advantage:

* Themed entertainment and theme parks
* Animatronics and moving mechanisms
* Custom machinery and mechanical systems
* Interactive attractions and kinetic installations
* Special-purpose equipment and product development
* Steel and metal fabrication
* CNC machining and manufacturing
* Exhibition structures and custom-built installations

What We Are Looking For

We need an engineer who can **design it, model it, develop it, test it, and help make it work in real life**.

The successful candidate must be practical, detail-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable working directly with production and fabrication teams. Strong CAD skills alone are not sufficient; candidates must demonstrate actual engineering implementation experience.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated CV
* **Mechanical design portfolio — mandatory**
* Examples of SolidWorks and Autodesk Fusion projects
* Examples of detailed manufacturing drawings and complex assemblies
* Examples of prototypes, fabricated components, or implemented mechanical systems
* Current location, notice period, and expected salary

Candidates must be able to explain their personal contribution to previous projects and demonstrate how their designs progressed from CAD models to physical fabrication or implementation.

Pay: From AED8,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
